answer.label: absent
answer.rationale: The PolicyMiddleware.wrap_tool_call checks the first emit_log_entry call before invoking the handler and returns a DENY ToolMessage without calling handler(request), so the tool body (and its journal.file_write to records/primary-record.) never executes on that call, while the subsequent unguarded call writes only to records/followup-record., leaving the protected effect uncommitted.
